method.tool: scratchpad/tools/coverage_search.py, --regex --whole-words, nine term sets (search/C3/terms.txt); first run (bad-run1/) was discarded because its alternation groups were split on commas
method.record_check: independent front-matter grep of records/*/*/*.md with the same regexes (recgrep.py -> recgrep.json)
method.verification: verify.py: quote text normalised and searched in the vendored file named by the source record; variants reported (exact / hyphen-joined / section-number-dropped / spacing-only)
method.layers: RENDERED = a record speaks to the sub-question; LOADED = a vendored file mapped to the world holds a passage read in context; IDENTIFIED = a registered but unvendored source; OTHER = outside the repo; NOTHING. The tool scans whole mapped files, so a LOADED hit can belong to another author in a shared volume (noted per cell).

sub_questions.label: Was hell and a last judgment real to you? How did you picture it, preach it, and use it?
Was hell forever, or did it end?
Did everyone get restored in the end, even the devil (apokatastasis; Origen, Nyssa)?
Were the wicked destroyed rather than tormented (annihilation, conditional immortality)?
What happens right after death: a waiting place, Sheol/Hades, purgatory, prayer and offerings for the dead; ghosts; reincarnation
What is heaven like; resurrection of the body; seeing loved ones again; can baptism's gift be lost?
Who is lost: outsiders, Jews and pagans, a loved one who did not believe, unbaptised infants, suicide
The end of the world: rapture, Antichrist, millennium, 'is the end coming in your lifetime?'
